title: Asymmetric heterogeneous catalysis using crystalline porous materials
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00538D, Review Article
Teng Li, Yan-Ting Chen, Xiao-Bin Zhang, Rong-Rong Du, Lin-Na Ma, Ya-Qian Lan
This review discusses the design and synthesis methods and asymmetric catalytic applications of chiral crystalline porous materials, focusing on asymmetric heterogeneous reactions and chiral control mechanisms.
